Built **Backstabbers — Ludo** as a complete responsive browser game.

### Included
- Four playable colors: Coral, Teal, Gold, and Iris
- Two-dice rolling system
- Local pass-and-play style turns
- CPU turns for the other three players
- Token movement and selectable runners
- Capturing/backstabbing mechanic
- Bonus turns for doubles and captures
- Home lanes and finish state
- Win detection
- New game/reset button
- Sound toggle UI
- Responsive desktop/mobile layout
- Styled board, player list, dice panel, status messaging, and instructions

- `index.html`
- `styles.css`
- `app.js`
